component: funnel.v8 incident vs. claimed lifecycle completeness
claim: Status: the full lifecycle (entry gate → price resolution → durable tracking → exit evaluation → stale-data safety net) has now been systematically reviewed end-to-end... No further code gaps are known at this time.
observed_ground_truth: The funnel.v8 check is CRITICAL in the most recent watchdog fast run, firing continuously with 6504 consecutive failures since first_seen 1786748706, still active at the fast-run timestamp 1789634704 with no recovered_at. A concrete stuck candidate (event_id bd6003380054eb57) is cited as having entered telegram_received with no terminal disposition.
expected_ground_truth: If the claimed end-to-end lifecycle review and stale-data safety net (stale_deadman closure, deadman logic, batched fallback) were fully deployed and effective, funnel.v8 would be expected to recover or at least show reduced failures, not remain FIRING with thousands of consecutive failures through the latest run.
operational_impact: The claimed fix does not appear to have resolved the underlying funnel/exit-tracking issue that watchdog is actively alerting on, meaning live positions may still be getting stuck without terminal disposition despite deploy claims.
suggested_next_step: Query the funnel.v8 check detail for event_id bd6003380054eb57 and cross-reference its entry/exit timestamps against commit b94ced5's deploy time to determine whether this candidate predates or postdates the claimed fix.

component: Uncommitted working tree vs. claimed clean deploy
claim: Committed b94ced5, deployed... Committed b93b9de, deployed, live-verified clean (zero errors, zero duplicate open positions on the actual live book post-restart).
observed_ground_truth: EV002 shows the working tree is NOT clean: 5 modified tracked files and ~19 untracked paths, including two ad-hoc scripts (p15_1_2_audit.py, scratch_incident_check.py) at repo root, at the time of the audit snapshot.
expected_ground_truth: A claim of clean commit-and-deploy for both b94ced5 and b93b9de would typically imply a clean or near-clean working tree post-deploy, absent unrelated ad-hoc scratch files.
operational_impact: Uncommitted changes alongside claimed deploys raise the risk that what's running differs from what was reviewed/tested, or that scratch/debug artifacts are mixed into the production checkout.
suggested_next_step: Run `git diff` and `git status --porcelain` on the deployed host to enumerate exactly which of the 5 modified tracked files differ from HEAD and whether they relate to the claimed exit-lifecycle or TOCTOU fix.
